Gate status on change 1117: **Verified +1** (CI SUCCESS, https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30649890441, voted 17:30). **LLM-Review still pending** — the review bot has posted nothing at all on this change (no STARTED message).

This looks like a repo-wide review-bot stall rather than anything about this change: every change uploaded this afternoon is in the same state (1116, 1117, 1118 all Verified +1 / LLM-Review pending, latest 17:45), while every change from this morning and earlier carries LLM-Review +1 (1104, 1102, 1100, 1090). The last LLM-Review vote landed around 11:09 today.

Ticket deliberately left `in_progress`: the change cannot be submitted without LLM-Review +1, and the close precheck requires the merged `rebar-ticket:` commit reachable from the worktree HEAD, so closing is blocked on landing regardless. The worktree `../bug-5546-sync-refspec` is retained for the follow-up (fast-forward, then close once submitted).

Next step for whoever picks this up: once the review bot recovers, confirm LLM-Review +1, Submit, then from inside the worktree `git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main` before `rebar transition 5546-65da-f42a-4cce in_progress closed`.
